<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the molecule contains a carbonyl carbon (≈168 ppm) and an aromatic ring (six aromatic carbons around 127–134 ppm). A plausible way to reconstruct the whole structure is to consider two fragments that can be joined: an aromatic fragment and a carbonyl‑containing fragment. The aromatic fragment is represented by the SMILES “c1ccccc1”. The carbonyl fragment that can connect to the aromatic ring is a carboxylic‑acid carbonyl, SMILES “C(=O)O”. Joining these gives the full molecule benzoic acid (O=C(O)c1ccccc1). Therefore, the list of joinable fragments is: ['c1ccccc1', 'C(=O)O'].</thought>
<final_answer>['c1ccccc1', 'C(=O)O']</final_answer>
